execution_mode: CPU-only, deterministic (pinned seeds, no wall-clock measurements)

target_claims.claim: ETTFS-init addresses the signal-diminishing problem caused by Kaiming initialization and stabilizes post-synaptic current distributions across layers (Figure 1).
target_claims.scale: toy-scale simulation (6 layers x 128 units, 32 time-steps)

target_claims.claim: The temporal weighting decoder reduces average inference time-steps compared with the prior TQ-TTFS decoder across four datasets (Figure 1d).
target_claims.scale: toy-scale: four synthetic input regimes, not the paper's four datasets

target_claims.claim: The paper argues max-pooling violates TTFS single-spike constraints, while average-pooling preserves them (Abstract).
target_claims.scale: exact numerical property check on simulated post-synaptic currents

target_claims.claim: ETTFS reports 99.48% on MNIST, 92.90% on Fashion-MNIST, 90.56% on CIFAR10, 70.27% on CIFAR100, and 95.83% on DVS Gesture for step-by-step TTFS SNNs (Table 1).
target_claims.scale: requires MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR/DVS-Gesture training runs on GPU

evidence.reason: Dataset-scale accuracy claims need full training on five datasets; this CPU-only reproduction does not attempt them and reports no accuracy for them.

target_claims.claim: A Fashion-MNIST ablation improves from 89.61% baseline accuracy to 92.90% when ETTFS-init, average pooling, normalization, affine normalization, and TWD are all enabled (Table 4).
target_claims.scale: toy-scale synthetic 3-class task trained from scratch, not Fashion-MNIST
